text: PR #130's CI passed on its branch, but the squash GitHub made on merge (39962ed) carried two jobs (60r4, sg0j) and failed the full-history check on main, so main went red at 12:55 UTC 2026-10-17. Before requesting the merge, land should build the squash it will create on top of the current main and run the full-history check on it, refusing to merge if it fails. (A by-hand simulation of exactly this caught nothing wrong for the next landing.)
